hadith:
Judgments (Ahkaam) - Narrated Um Salama:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I am only a human being, and you people (opponents) come to me with your cases; and it may be that one of you can present his case eloquently in a more convincing way than the other, and I give my verdict according to what I hear. So if ever I judge (by error) and give the right of a brother to his other (brother) then he (the latter) should not take it, for I am giving him only a piece of Fire." (See Hadith No. 638, Vol. 3).
message: Prophet Ibrahim’s prayer reminds us to seek guidance while leaving judgment and mercy to Allah. The Prophet ﷺ warned that a persuasive case does not make an unjust claim rightful. Allah, Al-Muhsi, knows and records all things, so act with sincerity and fairness.
name:
Al Muhsi - الْمُحْصِي - The All-Enumerating

Al Muhsi expresses Allah's complete enumeration and knowledge of all things. Quran 72:28 and 78:29 describe His counting and recording through verbs. The relevant root is ح ص ي, as in أحصى, rather than ح ص ر.
verse:
Ibrahim - Abraham - 14:36

My Lord! They have caused many people to go astray. So whoever follows me is with me, and whoever disobeys me—then surely You are ˹still˺ All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
